summary: Root Expo Router layout: themed native Stack (header and background follow light/dark) with route error recovery.
usage: Copy src/foundations/navigation/RootLayout.tsx to app/_layout.tsx (with accounts: auth/ProtectedLayout.tsx instead). Routes: app/index.tsx, app/<things>/[id].tsx (push), app/<things>/new.tsx (focused editor). Read params with useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>().
constraints: One root Stack; add (tabs) only for 3+ persistent peer areas.
Never hide native back without an in-content back action.
Import the router Stack in layouts and the UI Stack in screens.

summary: Route-level recovery screen for Expo Router, a subtree ErrorBoundary, and a single error-reporting hook.
usage: export { RouteErrorBoundary as ErrorBoundary } from '@/src/foundations/error-boundary/RouteErrorBoundary'; (in app/_layout.tsx covers every route). setErrorReporter(fn) at startup to forward errors.
constraints: Do not show raw error messages to users.

summary: Typed HTTP client (timeouts, abort, GET retries, one ApiError with user-safe messages), an in-app mock backend with latency and failure modes, and useResource/useMutation screen state that keeps data visible during refresh.
constraints: Put endpoint functions in src/features/<feature>/api.ts; screens call those, not the client.
Writes are not retried automatically; let the user retry.

summary: Save typed, versioned data on the device so it survives restarts (expo-sqlite key-value) with validation, migrations and serialized writes; secure backend for tokens; useStore hook.
usage:
export const rsvpStore = createStore<Record<string, boolean>>({ key: 'rsvps', version: 1, defaults: {}, backend: deviceBackend, validate: RsvpSchema.parse });
const { value, update } = useStore(rsvpStore);
constraints: Bump version and add migrate() when the stored shape changes.
Tokens and secrets only in secureBackend (values under ~2 KB).

summary: zod schemas to per-field form errors (fits TextField error and recipe.form-screen validate) plus common text and ISO date rules.
usage:
const EventForm = z.object({ title: requiredText('Title', 3, 80), date: isoDateNotPast('Date') });
<FormScreen validate={validatorFor(EventForm)} … />
constraints: Reuse the same schema to parse API responses (parse: Schema.parse).

summary: Fail-fast, typed EXPO_PUBLIC_* configuration with all problems reported at once.
usage: export const env = readEnv(z.object({ EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL: z.url() }), { EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL: process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL });
constraints: Write each process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_* out literally or Expo will not inline it.
Never put secrets in EXPO_PUBLIC_*; they ship in the bundle.

summary: Provider-neutral auth contract (AuthAdapter), session state machine, AuthProvider/useAuth, and a mock adapter; includes ProtectedLayout (Stack.Protected (app)/(auth) groups).
usage: Use auth/ProtectedLayout.tsx as app/_layout.tsx; put signed-in routes in app/(app)/ and sign-in in app/(auth)/. const auth = useAuth(); await auth.signIn({ email, password });
constraints: Implement one AuthAdapter for the chosen provider before release; the mock adapter is for development only.
Recovery and sign-up flows come from the provider; record them in identity.recovery.
